Results.ReviewText:
The Original Kettle grill is my go to standard and holds a real place of honor in our home... This was the model my dad always had on our porch when I was growing up, always a Webber kettle, never propane.  After I graduated from college and started making a home with my now-wife, we invited him over to a cook-out for my stepson's 4th birthday.  We had a little tiny hibachi from the grocery store we were going to cook hotdogs on. My dad went out and bought us our first Webber as a gift. It meant a lot.   
We held on to that grill for 15 years! (And technically, it was still in working order for the most part). But this year, just before Thanksgiving, I decided it was time to treat myself to an upgrade.  I looked over all the options, but in the end, it was undeniable that the classic kettle grill serves me perfectly, and never complicates the goal and reason I like grilling- standing outside, cooking with fire and smoke, making delicious food that keeps your family close. 

We live in an urban row home, and this grill is ideal for the front porch. It does not take up much space, it's easy to move around, and (pretty) easy to clean. I never have to plug it into an outlet, and it does not require me to keep a tank of propane sitting around.  It's also completely understated- not to flashy or attractive to passers-by, and somewhat unassuming. But in performance, it punches above it's weight- grilling, searing, smoking, I can easily fire it up to grill a couple of sausages or cook a platter of hot dogs and burgers, sear up some chicken thighs or smoke 30 wings, and I've used it for our Thanksgiving turkey for the past 5 years.  
In buying the new model I was a little skeptical about the price jump to the "Premium" model, but after we've used it 4-5 times, I'm really glad we went with it.  The heat shield under the handle is a great improvement (on the last model I had for 15 years, the handle melted after we used some pretty big/dense lump of charcoal on time). I also really love the built-in thermometer. I love using my kettle grill as a smoker, and having the thermometer built-in is really handy.   But the biggest improvement is the ash catcher. Having this bin is excellent and really helps keep the ashes tidy and easy to remove and dispose of. I always hated emptying ashes from the old flat plan because they would inevitably spill and blow all over the porch; the new system is super convenient and works perfectly. 

I 100% commend Webber for keeping this classic piece of home cooking, and making the slight improvements they have.  Our son is now 19, and I'm looking forward to the day I can gift him his first kettle grill once he settles down.
Results.Title: Kettle Premium adds to our family tradition

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
